description: Historical planning demonstration for week 146; forecasts generated from the local project tools, not live current-week demand. No final evaluation rerun.

contexts.source: hgb model refit on all observed weeks <= history_end_week; target-week prices and promotions from the planning row; range from hgb's own errors (weeks 116-125).

forecast_record.provenance: hgb model refit on all observed weeks <= history_end_week; target-week prices and promotions from the planning row; range from hgb's own errors (weeks 116-125).
assumptions: Forecasts are observed weekly orders, not guaranteed demand.
The range is model uncertainty only (about 80% of past outcomes fell inside it); manager context is applied separately by the decision tools.
hgb assumes next week's prices and promotions are known when planning.
Meal names and recipes are not in the data; meals are identified by ID, category and cuisine.
